lina: heads up — saw customers hit missing trace/request_id when our python async client starts background streaming tasks. traceparent present on incoming request but gone inside SDK's background task. reproducible with FastAPI.

lina: minimal repro: 
```python
# example.py
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
import asyncio
from redwood_sdk import AsyncClient
app = FastAPI()
client = AsyncClient()
@app.post('/g')
async def g(req: Request):
    async def bg():
        # no traceparent / no structlog bound request_id here
        await client.stream('hi')
    asyncio.create_task(bg())
    return {"ok": True}
```

evan: yep, contextvars aren't copied into new tasks by default. Two approaches: (1) fix SDK to spawn tasks via a captured context, or (2) document the create_task caveat. We should do both.

sam: for (1) the pattern is tiny:
```python
import contextvars, asyncio
def spawn(coro):
    ctx = contextvars.copy_context()
    return asyncio.create_task(ctx.run(coro))
```
But careful: if the SDK accepts a coroutine factory vs coroutine instance the wrapper differs.

lina: +1 on both. Customers want a copyable example (FastAPI + opentelemetry + structlog + our SDK) showing correct propagation. Also want a short README blurb until we release a fix.

sam: on the public API side we should add an optional Observability API on AsyncClient so consumers can register hooks to bind request_id into logs or forward span context. Proposal (typed):
```python
from typing import Protocol, Mapping
class Observability(Protocol):
    async def on_start(self, ctx: Mapping[str,str]) -> None: ...
    async def on_end(self, ctx: Mapping[str,str], meta: Mapping[str,str]) -> None: ...
```
This is small and plays nicely with static typing.

ev an: I'll prototype: 
- patch streaming path to use contextvars.copy_context() when spawning tasks
- add async Observability hooks to AsyncClient ctor with a no-op default
- add examples/fastapi/context-propagation sample that binds request_id into structlog
I'll open a draft PR and link it.

doc-bot: Created issue #1452: "py-sdk: preserve contextvars in async streaming + observability hooks" https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1452

ops: please add a test that spins up an instrumented FastAPI app, calls the endpoint, and asserts the tracer sees the background child span and logs include request_id inside background task. Also tag as backport-candidate for security-sensitive customers.

lina: great — i'll start the sample and push a branch, will paste link. also we should add a tiny note in the SDK README about older Python versions (3.7/3.8) and contextvar quirks.

ev an: draft PR posted, assigning to me. will ping when ready for review.

sam: one gotcha to watch: if we run ctx.run(coro) and coro is a coroutine object (not a callable), ctx.run expects a callable — wrap: ctx.run(lambda: asyncio.create_task(coro)) or accept a factory. include both patterns in the example.

lina: thanks all — this should clear up a lot of customer confusion. :thumbsup:
